evidence: The main conditions for ALE discussed in this paper are the following: Precursors were alternately supplied to a GaAs substrate without thermal cracking in an UHV chamber. For ALE of GaAs, the combination of TEG and TDMAAs was used. For ALE of AlAs, the combination of TMAAI and TDMAAs was used. In one typical cycle of the alternate supplies, the durations in which the precursors were supplied were fixed to 1 s. The following purging times after the supply of precursors were used, unless otherwise noted. The purging time after the TEG supply for the ALE of GaAs was set to 10 s and that after the TMAAl supply for the ALE of AlAs was set to 5 s. The purging time after the TDMAAs supply was set to 18 s.
